name: Convex for Claude Code
install_or_access_method: /plugin install convex@claude-plugins-official
notes: Parent plugin. The bundled skills, agents, MCP server, hooks, and monitors below are not separately installed.

name: add
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Adds capabilities to the current Convex application by consulting a served capability catalog or falling back to component search. Optional components: ["@convex-dev/static-hosting"]

name: agent
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Adds an AI agent, chatbot, or RAG backend to a Convex project using durable threads, message history, and vector search. Optional components: ["@convex-dev/agent"]

name: auth
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Add end-to-end authentication to a Convex web application using passkeys, OAuth, or passwords. Optional components: ["@convex-dev/auth", "jose"]

name: billing
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Integrate Stripe billing, payments, and subscriptions into a Convex application using the @convex-dev/stripe component. Optional components: ["@convex-dev/stripe"]

name: convex-authz
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Audit and harden a Convex application's authorization by identifying and fixing common security defects like identity impersonation and missing ownership checks. Optional components: []

name: crons
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Set up recurring scheduled jobs on Convex for tasks such as digests, cleanups, polling, and retries. Optional components: []

name: design
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Design and build reactive, type-safe, production-grade backends on Convex. Optional components: ["@convex-dev/aggregate", "@convex-dev/agent", "@convex-dev/rag", "@convex-dev/workflow", "@convex-dev/rate-limiter", "@convex-dev/migrations", "@convex-dev/workpool", "@convex-dev/auth"]

name: domains
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Connect an existing domain to a Convex application by providing DNS records and configuring authentication rebinding. Optional components: ["GoDaddy", "Namecheap", "Cloudflare"]

name: env
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Sets and wires deployment environment variables and secrets for a Convex app, storing them in the Convex environment for secure access in actions. Optional components: []

name: improve-convex-plugin
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Sends the current coding session's transcript to the Convex quickstart backend for an AI post-mortem to improve the system's runbook, bootstrap script, and skills. Optional components: []

name: labs-quickstart
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Scaffolds a Next.js application with a Convex backend, passkey authentication, and an integrated feedback panel for a complete development-to-deployment experience. Optional components: ["@convex-dev/auth", "next", "shadcn-ui"]

name: migrate
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Safely migrate the schema and backfill data on a deployed Convex app using the @convex-dev/migrations package. Optional components: ["@convex-dev/migrations"]

name: quickstart
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Scaffold and build a running Next.js and shadcn app backed by Convex from a one-sentence idea. Optional components: []

name: seed
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Seeds the Convex database with starter data or imports existing datasets while maintaining idempotency and schema compliance. Optional components: []

name: suggest
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Proactively suggest the right Convex component when a user's code or intent duplicates existing Convex components or built-in features. Optional components: ["@convex-dev/crons", "@convex-dev/sharded-counter", "@convex-dev/aggregate", "resend", "@convex-dev/rate-limiter", "@convex-dev/presence", "@convex-dev/workflow", "@convex-dev/rag", "@convex-dev/prosemirror-sync", "expo-push", "@convex-dev/workpool"]

name: test
install_or_access_method: Bundled with Convex for Claude Code
notes: Generate tests for Convex functions with convex-test using an in-memory backend to verify queries, mutations, authentication, and scheduling. Optional components: ["convex-test", "vitest"]
